tools.name: read_inputs
tools.description:
Select one target mode and provide only its parameters.

address: Read a slave's cyclic input bytes, returned as hex in raw_data_hex.

        Fails if the slave does not answer or has fewer input bytes than requested.
        

alias: read_inputs for the slave behind an alias from SLAVE_MAP_FILE.
With pyprofibus, the first I/O call may start and parameterize the master and transmit configured initial outputs. Requires PROFIBUS_BUS_ENABLED; read_only MCP policy denies this tool in every backend.

length.description: Number of input bytes to read (1-244). Omit to read all of the slave's input bytes.

tools.name: write_outputs
tools.description:
Select one target mode and provide only its parameters.

address: Write output bytes to a slave. This changes physical outputs on the equipment.

        Refused unless PROFIBUS_WRITES_ENABLED=true (default false); nothing is sent when refused.
        

alias: write_outputs for the slave behind an alias. This changes physical outputs on the equipment.

        Refused unless PROFIBUS_WRITES_ENABLED=true (default false); nothing is sent when refused.
        
With pyprofibus, requires PROFIBUS_BUS_ENABLED and a complete configured output image. Success means local process-image acceptance (outcome=submitted), not a DP acknowledgement or verified physical effect.

data.description: Output bytes to write, each 0-255, starting at the first output byte.

tools.name: read_diagnosis
tools.description: Read actual slave diagnostics. With pyprofibus, waits for the next observed Slave_Diag response from the configured master cycle; requires diag_period > 0 and PROFIBUS_BUS_ENABLED. The first call can start and parameterize the master and transmit configured initial outputs, so read_only MCP policy denies this tool and its communication-test alias. Freshness means reception after admission, not device acquisition time. Extended diagnostic bytes are preserved without vendor decoding.

tools.name: load_gsd_file
tools.description:
Parse a PROFIBUS DP GSD file (ASCII keyword format): vendor, model, ident number, baud rates, modules.

        Each module's I/O lengths are decoded from its configuration bytes. A bare file
        name is also looked up in PROFIBUS_GSD_PATH. Does not touch the bus.
